The precheck at `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:586-613` has no provider-outage condition, and the comment at lines 599-604 explicitly documents the omission ("No provider-outage precheck (deliberate, #8952)"). The implementation relies on `newer_failure_marker`, which does not cover the label-marker resume path (`provider_outage.py:776-786`, the marker is written to the labelled item — usually the linked issue, not the PR — so the gate's PR-comment read cannot see it). A resume dispatch for a clean head with no newer PR-side failure marker is therefore treated as an ordinary dispatch and skipped. The README row for `AUTOFIX_SKIP_CLEAN_SAME_HEAD` and the `agents.d/8952-clean-same-head-skip.md` fragment were updated in the LAST RUN DIFF to document this deviation.
